checklists.title: 12-Month Wedding Planning Checklist
checklists.description: The golden standard month-by-month timeline for planning your wedding 1 year in advance without feeling overwhelmed.
checklists.summary: Planning a wedding 12 months out gives you ample time to secure high-demand venues, select top-tier photographers, and curate every detail at your own pace.
keyTakeaways: Months 12–9: Lock in venue, date, photographer, and total budget.
Months 8–6: Shop for wedding attire, choose bridal party, and book caterer.
Months 5–3: Send formal invitations, order wedding cake, and schedule hair/makeup trials.
Months 2–1: Obtain marriage license, finalize seating chart, and assemble emergency kit.

checklists.title: 18-Month Wedding Planning Checklist
checklists.description: Extended planning timeline for prime venue booking, luxury destination weddings, and custom attire design.
checklists.summary: An 18-month timeline provides maximum flexibility for booking in-demand weekend venue dates and customizing couture gowns.
keyTakeaways: Months 18–14: Draft guest list, evaluate luxury venues, and set savings goals.
Months 13–10: Secure venue, photographer, band/DJ, and event designer.
Months 9–6: Order custom couture dress, arrange room blocks, and plan engagement party.
Months 5–1: Track RSVPs, complete fittings, and conduct final venue walkthroughs.

checklists.title: 6-Month Accelerated Wedding Planning Checklist
checklists.description: Fast-track wedding to-do list focused on essential venue bookings, off-the-rack attire, and priority vendors.
checklists.summary: Planning a wedding in 6 months requires quick decision-making and prioritizing essential vendors immediately.
keyTakeaways: Month 6: Book venue, photographer, caterer, and officiant immediately.
Month 5: Buy off-the-rack or sample sale dress, send save-the-dates.
Months 4–3: Mail invitations, order flowers, and book rentals.
Months 2–1: Finalize headcount, get marriage license, and confirm music playlists.

checklists.title: 3-Month Express Wedding Planning Checklist
checklists.description: Streamlined express checklist for elopements, intimate weddings, and quick engagement celebrations.
checklists.summary: Execute an intimate or elopement-style wedding in 90 days by sticking strictly to high-priority items.
keyTakeaways: Weeks 12–9: Confirm venue/space, hire officiant & photographer, buy ready-to-wear attire.
Weeks 8–5: Send digital invitations, order rings, and arrange simple florals.
Weeks 4–1: Obtain marriage license, confirm ceremony script, and enjoy the big day.

checklists.title: $10,000 Budget Wedding Planning Checklist
checklists.description: Smart cost-allocation breakdown for executing a stylish, memorable wedding under $10,000.
checklists.summary: Host an elegant $10,000 wedding by prioritizing venue choice, buffet catering, and intimate guest counts.
keyTakeaways: Venue & Catering (45% - $4,500): Public parks, cozy restaurant private dining, or backyard tenting.
Photo & Video (15% - $1,500): Focus on half-day photography coverage.
Attire & Rings (10% - $1,000): Sample sales, suit rentals, and minimalist bands.
Decor & Buffer (30% - $3,000): Greenery, candles, DIY signage, and contingency fund.

checklists.title: $20,000 Budget Wedding Planning Checklist
checklists.description: Balanced budget breakdown template for a 75–100 guest wedding with professional vendors.
checklists.summary: A $20,000 budget allows for professional photography, open bar beer/wine, and a great DJ.
keyTakeaways: Venue & Food (45% - $9,000): All-inclusive banquet space or vineyard package.
Photo & Entertainment (20% - $4,000): 8 hours of photography and live DJ.
Florals & Attire (20% - $4,000): Designer gown, suit, and curated floral centerpieces.
Stationery & Misc (15% - $3,000): Custom invitations, favors, and emergency fund.

checklists.title: $30,000 Budget Wedding Planning Checklist
checklists.description: Full-service wedding budget template with live music, floral arches, and full-day photography.
checklists.summary: With $30,000, you can host 100–125 guests at an elevated venue with full bar service and custom decor.
keyTakeaways: Venue & Plated Dinner (45% - $13,500): Multi-course plated dining and full bar.
Photo & Video (18% - $5,400): Full-day coverage with secondary photographer.
Florals & Production (17% - $5,100): Statement ceremony arch and elevated tablescapes.
Attire & Planner (20% - $6,000): Designer wedding gown and day-of coordinator.

checklists.title: $50,000+ Luxury Wedding Planning Checklist
checklists.description: Comprehensive luxury budget tracker for multi-day events, full planner, and premium vendor teams.
checklists.summary: A $50,000+ budget enables luxury venue hire, full-service wedding planner, live band, and multi-day celebrations.
keyTakeaways: Venue, Fine Dining & Bar (40% - $20,000+): Premium historic estate or luxury ballroom.
Full Planner & Production (20% - $10,000+): End-to-end event styling and coordination.
Photo, Video & Music (20% - $10,000+): Cinema videography and 7-piece live band.
Custom Decor & Luxury Attire (20% - $10,000+): Bespoke florals, lighting, and designer couture.

checklists.title: Pakistani & Muslim Multi-Day Wedding Checklist
checklists.description: Step-by-step master checklist for Dholki, Mayun, Mehndi, Baraat, Nikkah, and Walima events.
checklists.summary: Organize multi-day festivities, complex bridal jewelry, vendor deposits across events, and catering logistics.
keyTakeaways: Event Logistics: Track separate venues, dates, guest lists, and catering for Mehndi, Baraat, Nikkah, and Walima.
Bridal Attire & Jewelry: Schedule fittings for Lehnga, Gharara, and Sherwani along with gold/kundan jewelry sets.
Stage & Decor: Reserve stage backdrop designers, henna artists, and dholak performers.

checklists.title: Indian Wedding Planning Master Checklist
checklists.description: Comprehensive organizing guide for Haldi, Mehendi, Sangeet, Mandap Ceremony, and Grand Reception.
checklists.summary: Manage multi-event itineraries, Baraat horse/car arrangements, priest booking, and gift distribution.
keyTakeaways: Multi-Event Coordination: Haldi, Sangeet choreography, Mandap setup, and Reception banquet.
Ceremony Essentials: Officiant/Pandit booking, pooja items, Jai Mala garlands, and Havans.
Guest Hospitality: Welcome bags, hotel blocks, and regional Indian cuisine catering options.

checklists.title: Destination Wedding Planning Checklist
checklists.description: Travel-focused checklist for international venues, guest travel logistics, and legal marriage requirements.
checklists.summary: Plan a stress-free wedding abroad with guest travel itineraries, resort room blocks, and local marriage laws.
keyTakeaways: 12–14 Months Out: Send Save-the-Dates with travel website link & passport validity reminders.
9–6 Months Out: Secure resort group rate codes, book site visit, and verify local legal marriage documents.
3–1 Months Out: Finalize welcome bag favors, group excursions, and airport transfer shuttles.

checklists.title: Backyard & Private Estate Wedding Checklist
checklists.description: Complete infrastructure checklist for tenting, generator power, portable restrooms, and noise permits.
checklists.summary: Ensure your home or private property wedding has all necessary utilities, permits, and guest comforts.
keyTakeaways: Infrastructure Check: Rent luxury restroom trailers, backup generators, and tent flooring.
Permits & Insurance: Obtain city noise permits, parking permissions, and event liability insurance.
Vendor Access: Confirm catering setup space, trash management, and outdoor lighting.

checklists.title: Intimate & Small Wedding Planning Checklist
checklists.description: Planning guide tailored for under 50 guests, micro-weddings, and intimate dinner celebrations.
checklists.summary: Focus on high-end guest experiences, gourmet dining, and meaningful personalized details.
keyTakeaways: Personal Touches: Handwritten letters for every guest, custom place cards, and premium favors.
Elevated Dining: Chef's tasting menu, wine pairings, and single-table family seating.
Relaxed Timeline: Extra time for conversation, portraits, and intimate toasts.

checklists.title: Ultimate Bridal Emergency Kit Checklist
checklists.description: Complete packing list of 35+ emergency items for wardrobe malfunctions, beauty touch-ups, and health.
checklists.summary: Never be caught off guard on your wedding morning with this exhaustive emergency bag checklist.
keyTakeaways: Fashion Fixes: Fashion tape, stain remover pen, safety pins, needle & thread, backup shoe pads.
Beauty Emergency: Bobby pins, hairspray, blotting paper, lip gloss, mini perfume, clear nail polish.
Health & Practical: Pain relief, mints, tissues, phone charger, water bottle, vendor contact sheet.

checklists.title: Wedding Day-Of Schedule & Timeline Checklist
checklists.description: Hour-by-hour schedule template from hair and makeup morning arrival to grand exit sparks.
checklists.summary: Keep every bridesmaid, groomsman, and vendor running on time with a minute-by-minute day-of schedule.
keyTakeaways: Morning (7:00 AM - 12:00 PM): Hair & makeup, bridal party photos, vendor arrival.
Afternoon (1:00 PM - 4:00 PM): First look portraits, ceremony room walkthrough, guest seating.
Evening (5:00 PM - 11:00 PM): Ceremony, cocktail hour, grand entrance, speeches, dancing & exit.

checklists.title: Wedding Guest List & RSVP Master Checklist
checklists.description: Guide to building guest tiers, tracking dietary requirements, seating charts, and thank-you notes.
checklists.summary: Master the A-list and B-list invitation strategy, plus-one policies, and RSVP tracking.
keyTakeaways: Tier Breakdown: A-List (Must-haves), B-List (Second round), C-List (Acquaintances).
Dietary Tracking: Track vegan, gluten-free, halal, kosher, and nut allergies.
Seating Chart: Group by family relationships, friend circles, and age groups.

checklists.title: Wedding Vendor Booking Order & Contract Checklist
checklists.description: Chronological vendor hiring order, deposit payment tracker, and contract clause red flags.
checklists.summary: Know exactly when to hire each vendor and what contract details to inspect before paying deposits.
keyTakeaways: Order of Booking: 1. Venue, 2. Planner, 3. Photo/Video, 4. Caterer, 5. DJ, 6. Florist.
Contract Verification: Check cancellation clauses, overtime hourly rates, and meal requirements.
Payment Tracking: Record initial deposit, mid-way progress payments, and final balances.

checklists.title: Wedding Reception Master Checklist
checklists.description: Every detail for dinner service, grand entrance, first dance, speech order, and cake cutting.
checklists.summary: Orchestrate an unforgettable reception with smooth transitions between dining, speeches, and dancing.
keyTakeaways: Entrance & Dances: Grand entrance, first dance, parent dances, open floor transition.
Toasts & Speeches: Limit speeches to 3–5 minutes each during salad or dessert course.
Night Finish: Cake cutting, bouquet toss (optional), final song, and sparkler send-off.

checklists.title: Wedding Decor & Floral Checklist
checklists.description: Complete list of ceremony floral arrangements, reception tablescapes, signage, and lighting.
checklists.summary: Never forget a single centerpiece, welcome sign, or aisle marker with this comprehensive decor list.
keyTakeaways: Personal Florals: Bridal bouquet, bridesmaid bouquets, boutonnieres, corsages, flower girl basket.
Ceremony Decor: Entrance arch/chuppah, aisle runner, chair tie-backs, welcome sign.
Reception Tablescapes: Centerpieces, table numbers, place cards, chargers, candles, menu cards.

checklists.title: Printable Wedding Planning Checklist PDF Guide
checklists.description: Downloadable & printable binder-friendly wedding checklist covering 12 months of tasks.
checklists.summary: A clean 4-page printable PDF checklist organized by month for your paper wedding binder.
keyTakeaways: Binder Ready: High-resolution printer-friendly layout for standard 8.5x11 paper.
Task Checkboxes: Empty checkboxes next to every task from Month 12 to Day 1.
Notes & Contacts: Built-in vendor contact sheets and payment log tables.
